001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.controller;
002
003import static android.Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION;
004import static android.Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION;
005import static android.Manifest.permission.CAMERA;
006
007import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
008import android.os.Bundle;
009import android.util.Log;
010import android.view.LayoutInflater;
011import android.view.Menu;
012import android.view.MenuInflater;
013import android.view.MenuItem;
014import android.view.View;
015import android.view.ViewGroup;
016import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher;
017import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts;
018import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
019import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
020import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat;
021import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;
022import androidx.core.view.MenuProvider;
023import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment;
024import androidx.fragment.app.FragmentActivity;
025import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle.State;
026import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner;
027import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelProvider;
028import androidx.navigation.NavController;
029import androidx.navigation.Navigation;
030import androidx.navigation.fragment.NavHostFragment;
031import androidx.navigation.ui.NavigationUI;
032import dagger.hilt.android.AndroidEntryPoint;
033import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.R;
034import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.controller.ExplanationFragment.OnDismissListener;
035import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.databinding.FragmentHomeBinding;
036import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.viewmodel.LoginViewModel;
037import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.viewmodel.PermissionsViewModel;
038import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.viewmodel.PinViewModel;
039import java.util.Arrays;
040import java.util.Map;
041import java.util.function.Function;
042import java.util.function.Predicate;
043import java.util.stream.Collectors;
044
045@AndroidEntryPoint
046public class HomeFragment extends Fragment implements MenuProvider, OnDismissListener {
047
048  private static final int PERMISSIONS_REQUEST_CODE = 674;
049  private static final String TAG = HomeFragment.class.getSimpleName();
050  private static final String[] permissionsNeeded = {ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION,
051      CAMERA};
052
053  private FragmentHomeBinding binding;
054  private LoginViewModel loginViewModel;
055  private PinViewModel pinViewModel;
056  private PermissionsViewModel permissionsViewModel;
057  private String[] permissionsToRequest;
058  /**
059   * @noinspection FieldCanBeLocal
060   */
061  private ActivityResultLauncher<String[]> requestPermissionsLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
062      new ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions(), this::handleGrantResults);
063  private NavController childNavController;
064  private NavController parentNavController;
065
066  @Override
067  public View onCreateView(
068      @NonNull LayoutInflater inflater, ViewGroup container, Bundle savedInstanceState) {
069    binding = FragmentHomeBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false);
070    return binding.getRoot();
071  }
072
073
074  @Override
075  public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
076    super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);
077    LifecycleOwner lifecycleOwner = getViewLifecycleOwner();
078    FragmentActivity activity = requireActivity();
079    ViewModelProvider provider = new ViewModelProvider(activity);
080    loginViewModel = provider.get(LoginViewModel.class);
081    loginViewModel
082        .getAccount()
083        .observe(lifecycleOwner, (account) -> {
084          if (account == null) {
085            parentNavController.navigate(HomeFragmentDirections.navigateToPreLoginFragment());
086          }
087        });
088    permissionsViewModel = provider.get(PermissionsViewModel.class);
089    activity.addMenuProvider(this, getViewLifecycleOwner(), State.RESUMED);
090  }
091
092  @Override
093  public void onResume() {
094    super.onResume();
095    // TOD 3/28/25 Setup navigation connection. Connect the nav controller to the appbar and use
096    //  the nav UI class to use bottom button with NavController
097    childNavController =
098        ((NavHostFragment) binding.mapsPinsFragmentContainer.getFragment()).getNavController();
099    parentNavController = Navigation.findNavController(binding.getRoot());
100    NavigationUI.setupWithNavController(binding.bottomNavigation, childNavController);
101    setupPermissions();
102  }
103
104  @Override
105  public void onDestroyView() {
106    binding = null;
107    super.onDestroyView();
108  }
109
110  @Override
111  public void onCreateMenu(@NonNull Menu menu, @NonNull MenuInflater menuInflater) {
112    menuInflater.inflate(R.menu.main_actions, menu);
113  }
114
115  @Override
116  public boolean onMenuItemSelected(@NonNull MenuItem menuItem) {
117    boolean handled = true;
118    if (menuItem.getItemId() == R.id.sign_out) {
119      loginViewModel.signOut();
120    } else {
121      handled = false;
122    }
123    return handled;
124  }
125
126  private void setupPermissions() {
127    permissionsToRequest = Arrays.stream(permissionsNeeded)
128        .filter(this::shouldRequestPermission)
129        .toArray(String[]::new);
130    Map<String, Boolean> permissionsStatus = Arrays.stream(permissionsNeeded)
131        .filter(Predicate.not(this::shouldRequestPermission))
132        .collect(Collectors.toMap(Function.identity(), (permission) -> true));
133    permissionsViewModel.updatePermissionsStatus(permissionsStatus);
134    String[] permissionsToExplain = Arrays.stream(permissionsToRequest)
135        .filter(this::shouldExplainPermission)
136        .toArray(String[]::new);
137    if (permissionsToExplain.length > 0) {
138      parentNavController.navigate(
139          LoginFragmentDirections.openExplanationFragment(permissionsToExplain));
140    } else {
141      onDismiss();
142    }
143  }
144
145  public void handleGrantResults(@NonNull Map<String, Boolean> grantResults) {
146    Log.d(TAG, grantResults.toString());
147    permissionsViewModel.updatePermissionsStatus(grantResults);
148
149  }
150
151  @Override
152  public void onDismiss() {
153    requestPermissionsLauncher.launch(permissionsToRequest);
154  }
155
156  private boolean shouldRequestPermission(String permission) {
157    return ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(requireContext(), permission)
158        != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;
159  }
160
161  private boolean shouldExplainPermission(String permission) {
162    return ActivityCompat.shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale(requireActivity(), permission);
163  }
164
165}
